title: Make "INFO: Pump unreachable" notification actionable?
symptom: The user wants to tap the "INFO: Pump Unreachable" notification and go directly to the Medtronic tab, but currently the notification is not actionable. Some users report that the notification may not appear at all, only an alarm sound and in-app banner, and the sound can only be stopped by force-closing the app.
cause: The thread does not establish a single root cause. It discusses that notifications are informational and commands are retried automatically, and that Android may disable notification channels after multiple dismissals, but no definitive cause is confirmed.
fix: The feature request was implemented in pull request #258, which made the notification actionable. For the missing notification issue, AdrianLxM suggests checking that all notification channels for AAPS are enabled in App-Info, as Android may ask to disable notifications after dismissing them multiple times.
evidence_quote: Thanks @StephenBrown2 for the feature request. It was not much work and will bring a lot of value! https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/258
